attr.desc: A Spotify-style music player for your handheld. Browse your MP3, OGG and WAV library, play, shuffle and repeat - all from the D-pad.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Put your music in sym3ctunes/music/ or /roms2/music/. Needs python3-pygame, installed automatically on first run if Wi-Fi is on.
attr.title: Sym3c Tunes
